hypotheses.T0_axes_are_frozen_from_discovery: Both axes are fit only on discovery and used unchanged on replication.
hypotheses.T1_source_token_lookup_is_insufficient: A discovery source-token mean lookup explains less than 50% of held-out coordinate variance for both axes.
hypotheses.T2_axis0_tracks_distance_within_token: After choosing orientation on discovery, Axis 0 predicts long-range versus local routing among identical source tokens with held-out pair-weighted AUROC at least 0.70.
hypotheses.T3_profiles_survive_one_edge_per_row: The mean profile cosine between ordinary top-32 poles and top-32 poles restricted to one edge per FineWeb row is at least 0.80.
hypotheses.T4_axis0_separates_local_and_long_range_: On replication with one edge per row, Axis 0 positive has median distance at most 8 and Axis 0 negative at least 17.
